Definition: to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill
BiblicalUsage: 1) to die, kill, have one executed; 1a)(Qal); 1a1) to die; 1a2) to die (as penalty), be put to death; 1a3) to die, perish (of a nation); 1a4) to die prematurely (by neglect of wise moral conduct); 1b) (Polel) to kill, put to death, dispatch; 1c) (Hiphil) to kill, put to death; 1d) (Hophal); 1d1) to be killed, be put to death; 1d1a) to die prematurely
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
